confidence_notes: Restaurant estimates draw on [Numbeo](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Punta-Cana) and [Wise](https://wise.com/us/cost-of-living/dominican-republic/punta-cana), though local data are sparse and prices vary. Cocktail and wine estimates use premiums over beer, informed by limited [menu checks](https://nowinpuntacana.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Terra_Negra_Drink_Menu.pdf). July accommodation figures are general-knowledge estimates; hostel availability and room rates are especially uncertain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Accommodation estimates use broader Caribbean resort-town patterns, adjusted for Punta Cana's resort concentration and limited budget-hostel supply.
